name: Voice Cloning
description: Synthetic voices impersonate a trusted person to pressure a target toward an unauthorized payment approval.
groundingNote: Synthetic voice demonstrations are used only to study social-engineering indicators in controlled environments.

name: Deepfake Video Calls
description: A fabricated video persona poses as bank support or technical staff during a live call and pressures the target to disclose verification details before a payment action.
groundingNote: The scenario focuses on recognizing visual impersonation and authority-pressure signals without collecting real credentials.

name: Hyper-Personalized Phishing
description: AI-crafted email or SMS messages use familiar context and urgency to steer a target toward a simulated payment authorization.
groundingNote: Synthetic messages help defenders identify personalization, urgency, spoofed identity, and payment-redirection cues.

name: AI-Built Fake E-Commerce Sites
description: A fabricated storefront uses polished product listings, reviews, and checkout prompts to model a fraudulent card payment scenario.
groundingNote: The storefront is represented as a safe mock artifact with no active payment processing or real merchant impersonation.

name: Fake AI Chatbots
description: A simulated support chatbot builds trust and guides a user through a fake card-verification conversation ending at a synthetic payment event.
groundingNote: The dialogue is synthetic and contains no real verification flow, credentials, or usable payment link.

name: Synthetic Identity Fraud
description: Fabricated identity attributes are combined into a plausible profile that attempts account opening before a simulated payment or credit event.
groundingNote: All identity attributes are invented and exist only for fraud-defense testing.

name: Deepfake Identity Verification
description: A synthetic face and liveness-check scenario models how an attacker might try to pass identity verification before a simulated account payment.
groundingNote: The scenario is a defensive mock and does not provide bypass instructions or process real identity data.

name: AI-Drafted BEC
description: An AI-drafted vendor or executive email models a payment-detail update request and the resulting synthetic transfer attempt.
groundingNote: The artifact is clearly labeled synthetic and avoids real organizations, credentials, and active delivery links.
